title: Design system
summary: The kit's defaults, light and dark: colours, type, radius and shadow, buttons, form controls, status, the update notice, rows, tables, cards, tabs, a dialog, the empty state, and the default layout.
purpose: Every default kit part and token in one page, with no app styling, as the app view of the default AppShell layout, full screen. Built from kit parts and theme tokens only.

fixture.install: npx shadcn@4.23.0 add theme button input checkbox badge item table card tabs dialog empty
fixture.usage: import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'  // the kit's parts, no app classes

notes: A reference page, not a flow: it has no gestures. Its fixture is held to the design check like every showcase fixture.
